units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 89b:13">Snh. 89ᵇ</cite> <he>כך עוֹנְשׁוֹ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="B00105"><he>בַּדּאי</he></cite>; <cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 30:4">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XXX</cite>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 54b:7">Snh. 54ᵇ</cite> top, a. fr. <he>ע׳ שמענו אזהרה מנין</he> we learn here the penalty, whence do we learn the prohibition? <cite ref="Yevamot 3b:15">Yeb. 3ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="A00962"><he>אַזְהָרָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Yevamot 47a:14">Ib. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>ומודיעין אותו עוֹנְשָׁן של מצות</he> and we acquaint him (the proselyte) with the penalty attending the neglect of the duties (of an Israelite), v. <cite ref="P00290"><he>עָוֹן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 87a:8">Sabb. 87ᵃ</cite> <he>בתחלה פירש עוֹנְשָׁהּ וכ׳</he> first he explained the penalty for trespassing the Law, … and then the reward for observing it.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 88b:6">B. Bath. 88ᵇ</cite> <he>עוֹנְשָׁן של מדות</he> the responsibility connected with measures (the punishment for giving wrong measures); <cite ref="Yevamot 21a:6">Yeb. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>עונשין</he> (corr. acc.); a. fr.
<cite ref="Shabbat 115b:2">Sabb. 115ᵇ</cite> <he>גדול ע׳ האחרון וכ׳</he> the sinfulness of the latter act is greater than &c.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 105b:19">B. Kam. 105ᵇ</cite> <he>ע׳ ממון</he> (Rashi <he>ע׳ כפירה</he>) the crime of denying an obligation; <he>ע׳ שבועה</he> the crime of false swearing; a. fr.—Pl. <he>עוֹנְשִׁין</he>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 43b:11">Snh. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>ע׳ שבגלוי</he> sins committed publicly; a. e.
